name: Farm to Pet
description: Chicago-based independent maker of premium single-ingredient treats for dogs and cats, plus antler chews and food toppers, sold through FarmToPetTreats.com. Its Treat Ambassador (Our Pack) program runs through Shopify Collabs and pays creators flat cash commissions on code/link sales.

evidence.summary: Farm to Pet's official Treat Ambassador page fetched in full: accepted ambassadors receive a unique unlimited 10% discount code and link, and 'For every sale that is made using your personalized code or link, you will earn a commission of up to $10! - based on whether the customer is new or returning. There is no commission limit!' The explicit no-limit statement on the brand's own program page makes the commission cap UNCAPPED. The pay is a FLAT bounty (not a percentage), so commission_rate is null with the flat structure recorded here and in the terms evidence below.

The brand's official program terms confirm the flat structure exactly: $10.00 on all eligible purchases by NEW customers and $2.00 on purchases by RETURNING customers using the ambassador's code/link, paid via Shopify Collabs once at least $25.00 in commission is reached; eligibility requires age 18+ and a valid Shopify Collabs account.

The brand's official help centre states the gate honestly: ambassadors must have an active US-based pet-focused social media presence (Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and/or YouTube) with at least 1K followers, are chosen at the brand's discretion, and must post at least once per month and share content to the brand's upload app monthly. The brand's press page also publishes the program email ourpack@farmtopettreats.com. TikTok Shop and Amazon routes exist as extra channels but the recorded route is the brand's own Shopify Collabs program.

opportunity.title: Farm to Pet Treat Ambassador Program — flat $10 new / $2 returning per sale, 'no commission limit' per official page, via Shopify Collabs (1K+ follower gate)

reasons.niche_fit: Single-ingredient dog and cat treats are a natural, highly demonstrable pet UGC product with an easy taste-test content format
reasons.ugc_evidence: A dedicated creator ambassador program requiring monthly social posts and content uploads, with a welcome gift and collaborator invites on Instagram
reasons.compensation: Verified uncapped per the brand's own page, but the pay itself is a modest flat $10 per new-customer sale and $2 per returning sale
reasons.contact_access: Published program email (ourpack@farmtopettreats.com) plus the Shopify Collabs application on the official page
reasons.opportunity_availability: Gated: US-based pet-focused account with at least 1K followers, brand discretion, and monthly posting duties
reasons.credibility: Established independent Chicago treat maker with full program terms and disclosures published on its own site

name: Belkin
description: US consumer-electronics brand founded in 1983 selling chargers, cables, audio, smart-home and connectivity accessories through Belkin.com. It runs a Creator Affiliate program for social creators (10% commission, free product) alongside a publisher affiliate program on Impact.

evidence.summary: Belkin's official Creator Affiliate application page (on its GRIN creator platform) fetched in full: 'Apply below to be a part of Belkin's Creator Affiliate program. As a creator affiliate, you'll receive: 10% commission on sales, free product to try, review, and experience, early access to new product releases, exclusive event invites.' It publishes the affiliate support email globalsocial@belkin.com. The 10% creator rate stated on the brand's own creator page is the recorded rate. The page makes no earnings-cap statement, so the cap is unknown.

Belkin's official publisher affiliate page fetched in full: affiliates earn a commission based on the product's sale price, joining is free with no minimum sales requirements, and 'Impact Radius will pay by check, ACH, wire, or PayPal for a percentage of the sales you referred to our site after you have earned $50 in commissions.' Third-party listings for this separate publisher route conflict (4% / 8% / up to 10%), which is why the recorded rate rests on the creator program's own published 10%.

opportunity.title: Belkin Creator Affiliate Program — 10% commission on sales plus free product per the brand's creator page; publisher route via Impact

reasons.niche_fit: Chargers, MagSafe accessories and audio are everyday-carry tech staples with endless desk-setup, travel and unboxing content angles
reasons.ugc_evidence: A dedicated creator affiliate track with free product to review, early access and event invites — separate from the publisher program
reasons.compensation: 10% on sales per the brand's own creator page; accessories are mid-priced so per-sale dollars are moderate; no cap statement published
reasons.contact_access: Published affiliate support email (globalsocial@belkin.com) plus creator and Impact applications
reasons.opportunity_availability: Creator application reviewed by the brand; publisher route is a standard Impact application, free with no sales minimum
reasons.credibility: Four-decade global accessories brand, now part of Foxconn Interconnect, with both programs documented on its own pages

evidence.summary: Lasso's DreamCloud listing reports a FLAT $150 per mattress sale with a 180-day cookie. name: PetSafe

evidence.summary: PetSafe's affiliate program page was found and fetched ONLY on the brand's STAGING subdomain (staging.petsafe.com), so this evidence is flagged needs_review per the staging rule. The page states the program is 'perfect for pet parents, influencers and publishers with a strong online presence and loyal following', lists ideal partners as influencers, content creators, bloggers and publishers (coupon sites and sub-affiliate networks excluded), and sets guidelines including no bidding on PetSafe trademark terms. Lasso's PetSafe listing reports up to 9.0% commission with a 14-day cookie; a pet-program guide reports 8% with a long cookie, and Commission Factory's AU listing states 8% on every qualified sale with a 30-day cookie and AUD $100-$150 average order value.
